parameters.name: TotalNumberOfClients
parameters.description: Total number of MQTT clients registered with the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: NumberOfActiveClients
parameters.description: Number of MQTT clients, which have a connection with the MQTT broker established.

parameters.name: NumberOfInactiveClients
parameters.description: Number of MQTT clients, which have no connection with the MQTT broker established.

parameters.name: Subscriptions
parameters.description: Number of subscriptions held by the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: PublishSent
parameters.description: Number of publish messages sent by the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: PublishReceived
parameters.description: Number of publish messages received by the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: MQTTMessagesSent
parameters.description: Total number of MQTT messages sent by the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: MQTTMessagesReceived
parameters.description: Total number of MQTT messages received by the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: PublishErrors
parameters.description: Number of errors which prevented sending publish messages

object.description: The MQTT broker statistics values. These will reset with each MQTT broker start, either after reboot or if the MQTT broker gets (re-)enabled.
